description: UCI Online Retail data contract. Canonical column names are the source (CSV/pandas) names; stored_name gives the projection written to the retail_transactions table, so both representations come from this one document.

columns.name: Description
columns.note: Missing in a small share of source rows; unusual but not fatal.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.note: Stored as float64 because the retail_transactions column is declared Float.

columns.name: InvoiceDate
columns.note: stored_dtype is intentionally null: SQLite returns DATETIME as object while MySQL returns datetime64[ns], so asserting either raises false mismatches. Presence is still validated and the database enforces the real type.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.note: Absent for guest checkouts in roughly a quarter of source rows, which is expected and must not lower the score.

columns.name: Country
columns.note: Required at source even though the database column permits NULL; database nullability is not a source-level requirement.

derived_columns.name: IsCancellation
derived_columns.note: stored_dtype is intentionally null: boolean width differs per database driver.
